caption: The drawing depicts the front facade of a two-story building with white or light cream-colored walls, green window shutters, and architectural elements including tall white columns with ornate capitals supporting a roof overhang and a second-story balcony. The balcony has a green wrought-iron railing that matches the green columns and trim around the front porch. There is a prominent front door, centered and framed by the columns, with a small set of stairs leading up to it. In the foreground and to the left, a large vine or flowering plant with vibrant red, pink, orange, and purple hues climbs up and spreads across the columns and balcony. Black iron fencing borders the front yard area. Shadows of the railings and columns are cast on the walls, and the entire composition is rendered in delicate watercolor with soft, blended edges and a warm, sunlit atmosphere. The artist's signature, "Gilbert Sackerman," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Collonade
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
